text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Into the final stretch, the blitzkrieg 
comes down to the wire! Who will claim 
first place in the Centaur Stakes—!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (The final stretch. ...It's painful, but—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet. I can still... dive deeper. I 
can still keep going. Still.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet— My true speed starts from 
here—!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Tch, this...!! What incredible... 
tenacity—!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhhーー!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Believe takes 1st! It's Believe!! Coming 
out of the summer, she puts on a display 
of clearly evolved racing prowess!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reflexively clenched both fists tight. 
Beyond that hellish summer— a true, 
radiant light was waiting!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I felt a solid response. And what's 
more—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(It's not the feeling of "having perfected 
it." It's the feeling that "I can bring it 
to perfection.")

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (I can still... still dive deeper.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...If it's with Trainer. I can still—)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: All right, the Sprinters Stakes is next!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Light O-san— You're always getting 
ahead of yourself, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. The faster anything is, 
the better. I've always believed that. 
Yes—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, I want to go out.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's go out together before the Sprinters 
Stakes. Just the three of us: me, 
Durandal, and Believe.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Durandal—!! Here's the plan: meet 
up at the Hanshin Racecourse main gate 
later tonight at 20:00!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wait, what are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...And so, in the end... we decided that 
the three of us would do some sightseeing 
tomorrow before heading back to Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Discussing going on an outing on the turf 
right after a race feels rather 
unprecedented... but with Calstone Light 
O, I suppose there's no helping it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow was originally planned as a rest 
day anyway, so I tell her to just take 
good care of her condition ahead of the 
upcoming Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll be extremely careful. 
...And also.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In today's race... ...I felt the fruits of 
my summer training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Your smile. —Even in the middle of a 
crowd, I could see it clearly.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, the next morning... Believe 
headed out for their outing as a trio.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! I'm so sorry, have I kept you 
waiting?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, you're right on time. I only just 
arrived myself.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know when Light O-san got 
here, but she got tired of waiting and is 
sleeping on that bench over there."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Guu... turn right? Guu... straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...First, we need to wake her up.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
So? Inviting me out of the blue right 
after the race... Light O-san, where on 
earth did you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Nowhere in particular. It's not like I 
wanted to go sightseeing either.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to go out with you both. 
There's no point in just standing around, 
so let's walk.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-Hold on... wait a minute!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...For now, let's follow along.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived at quite the dazzling spot. 
It has a lovely atmosphere that makes you 
want to swear all kinds of vows, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to feel all emotional... Ah, 
standing here with the three of us brings 
back memories of our fateful meeting—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Was it fate, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No. Now that I recall, that wasn't the 
case at all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Well... if I had to say, it all started 
from the fact that we were in the same 
class.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Right after enrolling, Right O-san was 
such a chaotic mess that I just couldn't 
leave her alone—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You seemed to make sharp retorts, but you 
were actually pretty airheaded yourself, 
so the two of us often ended up totally 
lost in confusion together, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! I'd like to deny it, but you're 
right...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"And so, many of the girls tried to settle 
things down, but it was difficult—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...In the end, the task was entrusted to 
Believe-san, who was the calmest in the 
class."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think it was that big of a 
deal. Besides, if you just talk to them 
properly, they'll both listen."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, you're the only one who 
thinks that. Not getting swept up in my or 
Durandal's pace is a talent in itself.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I happen to be the type who ends 
up thinking only about work, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"You two also have clear paces of your 
own, so not having to match each other 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...How do I put it. It's just right, for 
me as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, since we came all this way, let's 
take a photo. Believe, since there are so 
many flowers around, give me some 
super-cute pose, please.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um, no thanks...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A pity. Then Durandal shall take the role.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna do it, though?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for some reason... Coming under an 
overpass like this brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Look, back when we did joint training, 
there was a place like this on our running 
course, remember?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You mean back when the instructors watched 
over us all together, before we were 
assigned Trainers... right? ...Yes, I 
believe that happened.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Yes, that's how it was... 
The three of us used to take breaks over 
there all the time, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A break? Wouldn't it be more accurate to 
say the three of us were collapsed in a 
heap together?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them was strictly 
built for sprinting, plus none of them had 
reached their prime yet back then.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When it came to long-distance running, I 
was constantly left in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And back then, I often used to think, 
'These same old faces again?'

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well... it certainly felt that way, yes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And then—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely during short-distance 
side-by-side runs that I found myself 
thinking 'not again' the most.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Believe again? Durandal again? They 
always keep up with my speed no matter 
what. —If anything, they try their hardest 
to surpass me."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Then there is no way I'm yielding to you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I will never surrender the title of 
'Fastest' to any of you." ...Before I knew 
it, that was what I had come to believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Even I... felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. So—so, I see. That's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's move. Somewhere that gets 
us, like, way more hyped up!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, honestly... Shall we go 
after them, Believe?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Right O-san bursts out right at the 
front. I hold on while keeping up the 
pace. And just when we tire out, 
Durandal-san comes flying in.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(That's how we've always been. Just like 
always, that's what we did.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (And then, Right O suddenly shouted.)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes! The one who will 
clock the fastest top speed of all—is 
me!!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I wanted the three of us to go out 
together before the Sprinters Stakes. I 
didn't quite understand why, but I just 
did.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Doing so made me realize. I wanted to 
talk to you. Or perhaps I should say, I 
wanted to make a vow. Because it's the two 
of you."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I get it now. It's been like that all 
along. Maybe ever since the day we first 
met.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Because Believe keeps inching closer and 
closer. And Durandal will always come 
flying in at the very end."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Light dwells within my legs. My heart 
burns, overflowing with power."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're all here. I can become 
faster and faster, with no limits."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —That is why I will dominate the race.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"At the Sprinters Stakes, in the end, I 
swear I shall cut every last one of you 
down!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san pushes the pace, Believe-san 
holds steady... And in that exact moment 
when all are pushed to their limits, my 
chance at victory shall arrive."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is because of you all that my holy 
sword shines even brighter. Even having 
seen today's race, I shall proclaim it 
once more: —I see no reason whatsoever why 
I would ever lose.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ............ I won't raise my voice, okay?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's no problem. That just makes your 
words carry that much more weight, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Our bond isn't so shallow that I wouldn't 
know that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"At the Sprinters Stakes, I will hold true 
to my conviction and hold out to the very 
end."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"When Calstone-san takes the lead, she 
naturally falls into high-speed mode. And 
when Durandal-san's overwhelming spirit 
bears down, that final burst of grit kicks 
in."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —It is easy to work with you all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I won't let anyone 
get in the way of my job. ...Not even 
you."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "...Indeed. Yes, you certainly are."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, nothing left to talk about. 
Right before the race on the day of, there 
won't be any overly emotional 
conversations anyway.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
All that's left now is to settle it by 
running.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I agree.
